Fresh Vietnamese reporting supplies a candidate roster: Namtai/Thong Thu, Thalao/Kheo, Meuangkeu, Phiengpheua/Kham, Mongnam/Pa Khom, Nakhang/Keo Muong, Sobdoung/Na Cai, Pao, Yothtiew and Daendin/Huoi Moi. This is distinct from a national ten-entry-point order.
